title: Copy-site destination register
statement: The destination register of a copy site is assigned as follows: $X$ and $QP$ target registers $2$ and $10$, respectively; $T$ and $TC$ target register $3$; $CN$, $CM$, $CU$, and $CT$ target register $4$; $MN$ targets register $8$; $KM$ targets register $9$; $UI$ targets register $13$; and $TU$ targets register $3$.
